title: IacModuleContribution
description: A deployable IaC unit: Terraform module, Helm chart, Kustomize base, CloudFormation stack template, Pulumi project. Groups IacResource / IacVariable / IacOutput contributions. Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (Rule 1): `IacScanKS` today; future tool-specific KSs.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the module root (directory or top-level descriptor). Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

sourceRef.description: Upstream module source (e.g. Terraform 'source' attribute, Helm chart repo URL).
